question: Which IIT inaugurated Asia's largest Shallow Wave Basin to advance research in ports, waterways, and coastal engineering?
solution:
The correct answer is __**IIT Madras**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **IIT Madras launched Asia's largest Shallow Wave Basin Research Facility** at its Thaiyur campus, 36 km from the main IIT Madras campus.
 
• The facility is **indigenously developed** under the **National Technology Centre for Ports, Waterways, and Coasts (NTCPWC)**, showcasing India's advancement in **coastal and marine engineering**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• It features a **multi-directional shallow wave basin** that enables analysis of **complex wave-current interactions**, critical for **ports, waterways, and coastal challenges**.
 
• Professor K. Murali highlighted that the facility eliminates the need for **external technological dependence** for wave generation and positions **IIT Madras on the global map** for research and industrial applications.
 
• Professor V. Sriram emphasized that the basin was developed as part of the **‘Make in India’ initiative**, with most components **designed, architected, and fabricated in-house**, ensuring sustainability and efficiency.
 
• Applications include testing **3D wave effects on structures**, studying **sediment transport, wave impact loading, and structural stability** under climate change conditions.
 
• The facility’s **modular wave makers and mobile mechanisms** support **multiple simultaneous projects**, making it versatile for both research and industrial needs.
 
• Professor Torsten Schlurmann of Leibniz University Hannover, a collaborator, acknowledged the facility’s **global significance**, enhancing IIT Madras’s position in **marine science and engineering**.
 
• NTCPWC, under the **Ministry of Shipping**, aims to facilitate **technological innovations, solutions for industry challenges, and educational research initiatives**.
